summary: Tested new portal features: (1) Admin category management with help_articles field - full CRUD working including slug rename, (2) Customer ticket history at /portal/my-tickets working. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified via Playwright - Portal home, category page with Related Docs, My Tickets, Ticket Detail, Admin Settings with PortalCategoryManager modal all working correctly.

admin_category_management.GET /api/portal/categories: PASS - returns all categories with help_articles field
admin_category_management.GET /api/portal/categories/{slug}: PASS - returns single category with help_articles
admin_category_management.POST /api/portal/admin/categories: PASS - creates category with help_articles (requires admin session_token cookie)
admin_category_management.PUT /api/portal/admin/categories/{slug}: PASS - updates category including help_articles and slug rename

customer_ticket_history.GET /api/portal/tickets/{ticket_id}: PASS - returns ticket detail with messages
customer_ticket_history.POST /api/portal/tickets: PASS - submits ticket as authenticated customer

frontend_ui.portal_home: PASS - 10 category cards displayed in grid
frontend_ui.category_page_with_help_articles: PASS - /portal/category/credits-pricing shows Related Docs section with 1 article
frontend_ui.my_tickets_page: PASS - shows ticket list with filters (All, Open, Waiting, Resolved, Closed)
frontend_ui.ticket_detail_page: PASS - shows ticket info, messages, reply form
frontend_ui.admin_settings_portal_categories: PASS - shows PortalCategoryManager with category list, edit/delete buttons
frontend_ui.add_category_modal: PASS - shows form with Title, Slug, Description, Icon selector, Subtopics, Help Articles quick-pick list

seed_data_creation: Created test tickets during testing. Test categories created and deleted during CRUD tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin category management with help_articles field is complete. Categories have help_articles array [{title, url}]. credits-pricing category has 1 help article. PortalCategoryManager component in /settings page allows admins to create/edit/delete categories with help articles from help.emergent.sh. Customer ticket history at /portal/my-tickets and /portal/my-tickets/{ticketId} working.
